+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+class DeadLetterError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+def send_to_dead_letter(message: Dict[str, Any], reason: str, destination: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    endpoint = destination or os.getenv("SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL")
+    if not endpoint:
+        raise DeadLetterError("Missing Slack webhook destination")
+
+    payload = {
+        "text": f"Dead-lettered message: {reason}",
+        "attachments": [
+            {
+                "color": "danger",
+                "fields": [
+                    {"title": "Reason", "value": reason, "short": False},
+                    {"title": "Message", "value": json.dumps(message, ensure_ascii=False), "short": False},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(endpoint, json=payload, timeout=10)
+    if response.status_code >= 400:
+        raise DeadLetterError(f"Slack dead-letter delivery failed: {response.status_code} {response.text}")
+
+    return {"ok": True, "status_code": response.status_code}
+
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import pubsub_v1
+
+
+def _get_env(name: str, default: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    value = os.getenv(name, default)
+    if value is None or value == "":
+        raise ValueError(f"Missing required environment variable: {name}")
+    return value
+
+
+def consume_one_message() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    project_id = _get_env("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
+    subscription_id = _get_env("PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION_ID")
+    subscriber = pubsub_v1.SubscriberClient()
+    subscription_path = subscriber.subscription_path(project_id, subscription_id)
+    response = subscriber.pull(
+        request={"subscription": subscription_path, "max_messages": 1, "return_immediately": True}
+    )
+    if not response.received_messages:
+        return {"received": False, "message": None}
+
+    received = response.received_messages[0]
+    message = received.message
+    payload_text = message.data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if message.data else ""
+    attributes = dict(message.attributes)
+    subscriber.acknowledge(
+        request={"subscription": subscription_path, "ack_ids": [received.ack_id]}
+    )
+    return {
+        "received": True,
+        "message": {
+            "message_id": message.message_id,
+            "payload": payload_text,
+            "attributes": attributes,
+            "publish_time": message.publish_time.isoformat() if message.publish_time else None,
+        },
+    }
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(json.dumps(consume_one_message(), ensure_ascii=False))
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+def publish_event(event: Dict[str, Any], topic: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    project_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"]
+    topic_id = topic or os.environ["PUBSUB_TOPIC"]
+    access_token = os.environ["GOOGLE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN"]
+    url = f"https://pubsub.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{project_id}/topics/{topic_id}:publish"
+    payload = {
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "data": json.dumps(event, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8").decode("latin1")
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        url,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
*** End Patch
